subject: Lawmakers want chaotic 'mega master' hearings at Chicago’s immigration court to end

Illinois Democrats have petitioned the Department of Justice to end mass immigration hearings in Chicago, citing severe overcrowding and lack of legal representation.

Social Physics Analysis:
The system uses the pretext of backlog clearance to justify rapid deportations. By projecting efficiency as the primary goal, it hides the active erosion of legal protections and shifts the systemic strain onto vulnerable families.

The Trajectory: Fall into Deception.
Mapping the gap between stated due process ideals and the reality of quota-driven mass hearings plots a trajectory toward Deception. Efficiency goals actively undermine justice.

The Unavoidable Truth: Mass hearings make a mockery of constitutional due process.
The Unavoidable Lie: Rushing hundreds of cases daily is about efficiency, not mass removal.
